newsitem.title: CANADA: Franco-Nevada to issue C$80 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Franco-Nevada to issue C$80 mln shares.

text.p: Franco-Nevada Mining Corp Ltd said on Friday it signed a deal with an underwriting syndicate to issue 1.6 million common shares at C$50 per share with an option to increase the issue to two million shares.
The shares will be issued via a short-form prospectus. The deal is subject to all required regulatory approvals, Franco-Nevada said.

Franco-Nevada said the C$80 million in proceeds will be used to develop its 50 percent share of the 25,500 acre Midas property in the Carlin Trend of northern Nevada where the budget was increased to US$12 million for 1996.
The company would raise up to C$100 million if the option to expand the issue was exercised.
The underwriting syndicate includes First Marathon Securities Ltd, Nesbitt Burns Inc, Gordon Capital Corp and Bunting Warburg Inc.
